title: Wrangler JL Unlimited
verdict: The four-door JL is the Wrangler with a choice of engines: a diesel, a plug-in hybrid and a 470-hp Hemi V8, all with solid axles and doors that come off. Pick the powertrain that suits how you travel, and check the recalls first. Several of them tell you to park outside.

paragraphs: The four-door was the JL that mattered most, so it came first: Wrangler Unlimited production began at Toledo in November 2017, months ahead of the two-door, and it ran alongside the outgoing [[jeep/jk-unlimited|JK Unlimited]] until April 2018 so dealers could keep up with demand. It grew 3.5 inches in overall length over the JK Unlimited, to 188.4 inches on a 118.4-inch wheelbase, while losing weight. It kept the separate frame, the solid axles and the removable doors. Then, over the next few years, Jeep gave it more powertrains than any Wrangler before.

story.heading: DIESEL, HYBRID, HEMI
paragraphs: Launch engines were the 285-hp 3.6 Pentastar, with optional eTorque, and the 270-hp 2.0 turbo four. For 2020 North America got the VM-built 3.0 EcoDiesel V6 with 260 hp and 443 lb-ft (600 Nm). It was dropped for 2024. The 4xe plug-in hybrid followed for 2021: the 2.0 turbo plus electric motors and a 17 kWh battery, for 375 hp, 470 lb-ft and an EPA-rated 21 miles of electric range.

Also for 2021 came the Rubicon 392, with the 6.4-liter Hemi V8 from Dodge's Scat Pack cars making 470 hp and 470 lb-ft. Quadratec's specs show it uses the full-time Selec-Trac case and the heavier ZF 8HP75 automatic rather than the Rubicon's Rock-Trac. Its 1,351-lb payload is the highest in the range. Jeep announced 'final editions' for 2024 and 2025, then reversed course in August 2025: CEO Bob Broderdorf said the 392 would stay, and a V8 Gladiator would join it.

story.heading: THE FAMILY OVERLANDER
paragraphs: For overlanders the Unlimited is the obvious JL. It tows 3,500 lb, or 5,000 lb with the 2024 full-float Dana 44 HD rear axle and the automatic on non-4xe trucks, and it has a cargo area that takes a fridge and drawers. Payload is the limit: Quadratec lists 880 lb for a 2020 Sahara and 892 lb for a Rubicon, so a steel-bumpered, roof-racked build overruns it fast. The JL Unlimited is also the basis for the Gladiator pickup, which borrows its styling and interior.

It isn't perfect. The IIHS rated it Marginal in the small-overlap crash test after a 2020 Unlimited rolled onto its side, and a 2022 retest ended the same way. The 4xe has been recalled for battery fire risk, and 2021–2025 trucks have been recalled for power-steering pump wiring. Both recalls told owners to park outside until repaired.

story.heading: 2024 AND BEYOND
paragraphs: The 2024 refresh brought the four-door the same updates as the two-door: a 12.3-inch Uconnect 5 screen, side-curtain airbags in both rows, a new grille, a windshield-frame antenna, an available Warn winch and the Rubicon X with 35s. The 4xe gained a cheaper Sport S trim and a four-outlet 'Power Box'. Wikipedia reports that Stellantis then dropped the Wrangler 4xe from the US market in 2025. The JL Unlimited competes with the Bronco, the [[land-rover/defender-l663|Defender 110]], the [[grenadier/station-wagon|Ineos Grenadier]] and the [[4runner/6th-gen|sixth-gen 4Runner]], and it's still the only one with doors you can leave at home.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · THE 4xe AND ITS FIRE RECALLS
callout.title: Park it outside, don't plug it in
paragraphs: In October 2024, KBB reported a recall of 154,032 2020–2024 Wrangler 4xe and 2022–2024 Grand Cherokee 4xe plug-in hybrids, because some high-voltage battery cells could be damaged and catch fire, parked or moving. Owners were told to park outdoors, away from buildings, and to stop charging until the repair was done. The remedy was a software update and, where needed, a new battery pack. AutoGuide reported that an internal review of customer data had turned up 13 fire incidents.
Before you buy a used 4xe, check NHTSA for completed recall work. Pickup Truck + SUV Talk lists both 24V-720 and the later 25V-741 for 4xe batteries.

engineering_intro: The JL Unlimited uses the JL's ladder frame, coil springs and solid axles on a 118.4-inch wheelbase. It has offered the widest engine choice of any Wrangler: gas V6, turbo four, diesel V6, a plug-in hybrid and a Hemi V8, all through 8-speed automatics, plus a six-speed manual on the Pentastar.

engineering.note: 188.4 in long; 3.5 in longer than the JK Unlimited (Wikipedia).
An M220 rear comes with the optional limited slip; a full-float Dana 44 HD rear was offered on the Rubicon from 2024.
The Rubicon 392 uses full-time Selec-Trac (MP3022) instead of Rock-Trac; Selec-Trac is otherwise a Sahara option.

engineering.note: 285 · 270 · 260 hp (443 lb-ft) · 375 hp / 470 lb-ft combined · 470 hp / 470 lb-ft.
The manual is offered only with the gas engines.

North America; dropped for 2024. Recall 23V-263 for the high-pressure fuel pump on some 2021–23 trucks.
21-mile EPA electric range. Battery fire recalls. Sport S 4xe added for 2024.
Selec-Trac full-time 4WD, ZF 8HP75. 'Final Edition' for 2025, then confirmed to continue.
12.3-in screen, side curtains, Rubicon X, Warn winch, Dana 44 HD full-float rear (5,000-lb towing).

buying_checks.head: Run the VIN for every recall
buying_checks.body: Look for the frame and track-bar welds and the steering damper on 2018–19 trucks, the clutch on manuals, the 2018 park-lock rod (18V-280) and cruise-control software (18V-332) campaigns, the power-steering pump (26V-363, 2021–2025), the 4xe battery (24V-720 / 25V-741) and the EcoDiesel fuel pump (22V-767 and 23V-263). Get dealer printouts showing they're complete.

buying_checks.head: 4xe: test the charging
buying_checks.body: Plug it in. Pickup Truck + SUV Talk says owners often complain the 4xe won't charge from an outlet, blaming software, connections or an overheating control module.

buying_checks.head: EcoDiesel: fuel and emissions history
buying_checks.body: Ask for fuel-filter receipts and the recall record. A high-pressure pump failure is expensive, and debris contamination is what the recall addressed.

buying_checks.head: 392: it's a different 4WD system
buying_checks.body: The 392 uses full-time Selec-Trac and the ZF 8HP75, not Rock-Trac. Check the differential and transfer-case fluids. KBB put a new 2025 Rubicon 392 at $101,990, so price used ones against the trim and condition.

buying_checks.head: Steering feel
buying_checks.body: Wandering or vague steering on 2018–2020 trucks points to the early aluminum steering box (owners cite TSB 08-074-20). Shake after bumps points to the damper, track bar or worn joints.

buying_checks.head: Pentastar oil cooler
buying_checks.body: Look for oil in the engine valley and down the back of the block.

buying_checks.head: Payload versus build
buying_checks.body: Read the door sticker, then add up the bumpers, winch, rack, drawers and passengers. Quadratec lists 880–1,351 lb for 2020–21 four-doors depending on trim.

buying_checks.head: Do you want the 2024 updates?
buying_checks.body: Side-curtain airbags, the bigger screen, a 5,000-lb tow option and the factory winch all arrived for 2024, the same year the EcoDiesel disappeared.

repairs.title: Fix steering wobble: damper, track bar, then the rest
repairs.time: ≈ 1–2 hours to inspect and fit a damper
repairs.cost: Free damper replacement on affected early trucks under FCA's 2019 customer-satisfaction program; otherwise a damper or track bar
repairs.symptoms: Front-end shimmy or full death wobble after a bump at 45–65 mph, with the steering wheel shaking side to side.
repairs.fix: On 2018–2019 trucks, check the history first. In August 2019 FCA began offering a stronger steering damper at no charge. FCA said its engineers found air could get into the original damper in cold weather, when the oil thickens, so it lost damping. Its Customer Satisfaction Notification V41 covered about 192,000 2018–2019 JLs. Then inspect the front end the same way as on any solid-axle Jeep: have a helper rock the wheel while you watch both ends of the track bar, then check the tie-rod and drag-link ends, ball joints, control-arm bushings and wheel bearings. Replace worn parts, torque everything at ride height, and get an alignment. A damper on its own masks wobble; it doesn't cure it.
repairs.tools: Helper · torque wrench · sockets · jack and stands.

parts.name: Synergy 8875-01 adjustable front track bar, JL/JT

repairs.title: Replace a loose aluminum steering box (TSB 08-074-20)
repairs.cost: JLWranglerForums members report dealer quotes of $1,500+ out of warranty
repairs.symptoms: Light, vague, loose steering and wandering on the highway, sometimes with play you can see at the pitman arm. One owner described it as 'super light, vague and loose' at nearly 100,000 miles.
repairs.fix: Early JLs used an aluminum steering gear, and Quadratec says Jeep moved to cast-iron boxes. Owners on JLWranglerForums cite TSB 08-074-20 for the swap (we couldn't see the bulletin itself), who also note it won't cure death wobble by itself. DIY: disconnect the battery, mark and remove the pitman arm with a puller, unbolt the intermediate shaft, disconnect the pressure and return lines (catch the fluid), then unbolt the box from the frame. Fit the new box with new bolts, refill and bleed the system with the specified fluid, and center the steering wheel.
repairs.tools: Pitman-arm puller · line wrenches · large sockets · torque wrench · drain pan · power steering fluid.

parts.name: Mopar 68250506AD power steering box, 2018–2020 JL Unlimited
Mopar 06512518AA short steering box bolt, 2018–2020 JL/JT

repairs.title: Replace a leaking Pentastar oil cooler / filter housing
repairs.cost: Housing assembly plus gaskets, coolant and oil
repairs.symptoms: Oil, and sometimes coolant, pooling in the valley under the intake and running down the back of the engine. Pickup Truck + SUV Talk lists cracked Pentastar oil-filter housings and cooler adapters as a known JL issue.
repairs.fix: The job follows the JK procedure. Remove the engine cover and intake plumbing, the upper and lower intake manifolds, and the cooler's sensors and bolts. Clean the valley, fit the new housing with new seals, then refill the oil and coolant and check for leaks. Torque the oil filter cap to 18 ft-lb; overtightening is a suspected contributor to cracking.
repairs.tools: External-Torx and metric sockets · inch-pound torque wrench · hose pliers · shop towels to plug the intake ports.

parts.name: Crown 68308741AF engine oil filter and cooler assembly, 2018 JL 3.6
Mopar/Dorman 68755454AA aluminum oil filter housing with element, JK/JL/JT (check fitment)

repairs.title: Power-steering pump: recall check, then replacement
repairs.time: ≈ 2 hours DIY; recall work at the dealer
repairs.cost: Free under recall 26V-363 where it applies; otherwise a Mopar pump
repairs.symptoms: Loss of power assist or a 'Service Power Steering' message. AARP reports that the June 2026 recall covers about 1,077,000 2021–2025 Wranglers and Gladiators whose electro-hydraulic pump connection can overheat and start a fire, even when parked. Owners were told to park outside until it's fixed, and at least 51 fires were linked to the fault.
repairs.fix: Check the VIN on nhtsa.gov first. If the recall applies, the dealer inspects and repairs or replaces parts free of charge, so don't DIY around it. For an out-of-warranty pump failure on a truck that isn't covered: disconnect the battery, drain the reservoir, unplug the pump's electrical connector and pressure/return lines, unbolt the pump, fit the new one, then refill with the Mopar electric steering pump fluid listed in the manual and bleed by turning lock to lock with the engine running.
repairs.tools: Line wrenches · drain pan · sockets · the specified power steering fluid.

repairs.title: EcoDiesel: fuel-pump recall and fuel-filter service
repairs.cost: Recall work free; a fuel filter for routine service
repairs.symptoms: Stalling, hard starting or a diesel smell. Pickup Truck + SUV Talk lists recall 23V-263 for possible high-pressure fuel pump failure on some 2021–2023 EcoDiesels, where debris in the fuel system can cause a stall or a fuel leak.
repairs.fix: Confirm the recall has been done. Then treat the fuel filter as a wear item, because the 3.0's high-pressure pump hates water and dirt. Relieve the pressure, change the filter, prime the system as the service manual describes, and check for leaks. Use only ultra-low-sulfur diesel; the owner's-manual sheet allows biodiesel up to B5, or B7 with shorter service intervals.
repairs.tools: Filter wrench · drain pan · rags · service manual for the priming procedure.

parts.name: Fuel filter catalog, 2021 Wrangler Unlimited 3.0 diesel

repairs.title: Fix 2.0T / 4xe coolant hose leaks
repairs.symptoms: A dropping coolant level, a sweet smell, or crusty residue around the turbo coolant lines or the coolant bottle hoses on a 2.0 turbo (the 4xe uses the same 2.0 turbo engine). Pickup Truck + SUV Talk lists a TSB for turbo coolant return line leaks.
repairs.fix: Pressure-test the cold system to find the leak. Drain enough coolant to get below the leak, replace the hose and its clips, refill with OAT coolant and bleed the loop. Remember the 2.0T has a separate intercooler loop, and that the 4xe also has high-voltage battery cooling. Leave anything orange-cabled to a trained technician. Check the dealer history too, since the TSB repair may already have been done.
repairs.tools: Cooling-system pressure tester · hose-clamp pliers · drain pan · Mopar OAT coolant.

parts.name: Mopar 68280800AE coolant bottle outlet hose, 2018–2020 JL 2.0L turbo
Mopar 68314788AA battery coolant cooler, 2018–2020 JL 2.0L turbo

repairs.title: Re-spring for an overland load
repairs.time: ≈ 2–3 hours for rear coils; a day for a full kit
repairs.cost: A pair of coils, or a heavy-load lift kit
repairs.symptoms: Rear sag, bottoming out on washboard, or the truck sitting on its bump stops once the drawers, fridge and water are loaded. Payload can be as low as 880 lb (Quadratec lists that for the 2020 Sahara four-door).
repairs.fix: Weigh the loaded truck at a scale first. Then fit springs rated for the real load: support the frame, unbolt the shocks and sway-bar links, lower the axle, swap the coils, and refit at ride height before torquing the bushings. For a permanently heavy build, a heavy-load kit with matched shocks is the better answer. Re-check the track bar and alignment afterwards.
repairs.tools: Floor jack and stands · sockets · torque wrench · access to a vehicle scale.

parts.name: Skyjacker 2.5 in dual-rate rear coil pair, 2018–2020 JL Unlimited
AEV N0724780AA DualSport XP 3 in heavy-load lift kit (Quadratec lists it for the JL Unlimited Rubicon 392; check fitment)

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: On a Rubicon, 35s. Driving Line ran 35x12.50R17s on a stock-height JL Unlimited Rubicon with bump-stop spacers and the factory flares. They cleared on level ground but hit the inner fenders when flexed. Performance Plus Tire says Jeep ships the Rubicon 392 on LT315/70R17s, which are nearly 35s (check early 392s: the 35s were also part of the optional Xtreme Recon package). Performance Plus Tire says a Rubicon 4xe has about 2.1 inches less clearance than the gas Rubicon, so it needs bump-stop extensions for 35s. On a Sport or Sahara, stay with 33s and a wheel change, or lift 2–2.5 inches for 35s.

3.6 if you want a manual or the simplest drivetrain; 2.0T for torque and economy; EcoDiesel (2020–23) for towing range; 4xe for silent electric trail driving and short commutes on battery; 392 for 470 hp. Each brings its own recalls, so check them before you choose.
3,500 lb for most four-doors. From 2024, Hagerty says the full-float Dana 44 HD rear axle raises that to 5,000 lb on non-4xe trucks with the eight-speed automatic.
Quadratec lists 1,190 lb for a 2020 Sport four-door, 880 lb for a Sahara, 892 lb for a Rubicon and 1,351 lb for the 2021 Rubicon 392. The door sticker on your truck has the real figure.

faq.q: Is the 4xe safe to buy after the fire recalls?
faq.a: Yes, once the recall work is done. The October 2024 recall covered 154,032 Wrangler and Grand Cherokee 4xe models, with a software update and, where needed, a battery replacement. Owners were told to park outside and stop charging until it was fixed. Confirm completion on NHTSA, and test that the truck charges.

faq.q: How far does the 4xe go on electricity?
faq.a: The EPA rates it at 21 miles and 49 MPGe on its 17 kWh battery. Hagerty says the 2024 update recalibrated E-Save mode to recover energy about 50 percent more effectively.
Not any more. Jeep announced final editions for 2024 and 2025, then in August 2025 CEO Bob Broderdorf said, 'We will extend the availability of the 392 on Wrangler,' and announced a V8 Gladiator too.

faq.q: What oil does each engine take?
faq.a: 3.6: 5 quarts of 0W-20 (MS-6395). 2.0T: 5 quarts of full-synthetic 5W-30, API SN PLUS (MS-13340). 3.0 EcoDiesel: 9 quarts of 5W-40 synthetic (MS-12991). For the 4xe and the 392, use the owner's manual [CONFIRM IN MANUAL].

faq.q: How did the JL Unlimited do in crash tests?
faq.a: Badly in one test. In the IIHS small-overlap test, a 2020 Unlimited's front axle tucked under the structure and the truck tipped onto its side. A 2022 retest ended the same way, so it was rated Marginal both times. Side-curtain airbags arrived with the 2024 refresh.

faq.q: Does the JL Unlimited get death wobble?
faq.a: It can, like any solid-axle Jeep. Early trucks got a free stronger damper in 2019. The cure is a tight front end: track bar, tie-rod ends, ball joints, bushings and bearings, followed by an alignment.

faq.q: What do I need to know about the power-steering recall?
faq.a: Recall 26V-363 (June 2026) covers about 1,077,000 2021–2025 Wranglers and Gladiators. A high-resistance connection at the electro-hydraulic pump can overheat and start a fire even when parked, and owners were told to park outside until dealers can inspect and repair it free.

mods.why: An overland four-door needs springs for its real weight. Heavy-load kits keep the ride height and up-travel once the drawers and fridge go in.

mods.why: Raises the intake out of dust and water, especially useful on long desert trips.
The 2024 factory Warn winch covers recovery. For earlier trucks, a winch-ready steel bumper is the usual first purchase.

baseline_service.intro: Baseline a used JL by engine. The 3.6 Pentastar, the 2.0 turbo, the 3.0 EcoDiesel, the 4xe and the 392 use different oils, plugs and cooling loops, and the 8-speed takes ZF-spec fluid, not ATF+4. Before spending money, run the VIN through NHTSA's recall lookup: JLs have had recalls for frame welds, clutches, power-steering pumps and 4xe batteries. Then change the gear oil, which owners skip most.

items.spec: 3.6: 5 qt SAE 0W-20 meeting MS-6395 · 2.0T: 5 qt full-synthetic SAE 5W-30, API SN PLUS (Mopar MS-13340) · 4xe: [CONFIRM IN MANUAL] · 3.0 EcoDiesel: 9 qt 5W-40 synthetic (MS-12991) · 6.4 392: [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]

items.note: The JL Pentastar takes a quart less, and a thinner grade, than the JK's: Quadratec specifies the Mopar MO-349 (68191349AA) cartridge, the 24 mm cap torqued to 18 ft-lb and the 13 mm drain plug to 20 ft-lb. The owner's-manual sheet warns that non-SN PLUS oil in the 2.0T 'can cause engine damage not covered by the vehicle warranty.'
